# Shared vault

Alex and Sam's shared context (Obsidian), kept by the Kokuban keeper on keeper-pc.

- [[Home|Home]]: every business and the shared tools.
- [[Rules]]: how people and agents write here; read it first.
- [[Needs attention]]: what the nightly check-up found.

One folder per business (Home, Pipeline and Care boards, Decisions, Clients/, Projects/). A client's own repositories sit in its folder; Shared tools/ holds the tools every business uses; Unsorted/ holds repositories not placed yet.

Design records: kokuban/docs/vault-keeper.md.
